title: Tit for Tat Reviews
author: RoundTableTTRPG
selftext:
Simple as that. Give me 5 minutes, give me a basic comment, bug fixes, impressions, review, and a link to your game, I will give you 5 minutes and the same

[https://remix-kasbah-builder-9-13-5152.ai.studio/](https://remix-kasbah-builder-9-13-5152.ai.studio/)

  
The underlying philosophy of this game is exploring the place of AI in game development. While it slops its way in sometimes, the core development, categories, game loop and assets are almost entirely human driven. There is a very basic sim-tower like core game loop, and instead of developing assets with AI or anything like that the idea was to make each individual 'Sim' have their own story lines, which are also human designed. The place where AI comes in is translating those stories and behaviours to code, which I see as the tedious part that can be a little sloppy.

comments.author: Reckonerxy
comments.body:
Tried your game, but tbh i did not understand how to play it. Seems like a sim build management game but i did not understand how to purchase stuff. A think adding a super simple tutorial in how to play your game your help you out a lot.

Here is my game btw. Its an rpg/roguelike turn based. UI is still pretty basic, but game is fully playable, im planning to work in ui polish and art/music soon. (best played on browser)

https://teotlan.com

replies.author: RoundTableTTRPG
replies.body:
thanks for trying it out. Here's my review for you:

First impression; the AI visual design is immediately obvious and not something I personally like. There are quite a few icons that don't render properly (they are just a box), and overall I don't like the use of text icons in menus like that.

I wish I could easily reference the stats of the attacks in battle, like how much damage the strike deals, same with slay for resources to show what the resources are that I get.

It feels like it's a very standard mechanical approach and the setting or premise is a passion of yours which is cool. I would be interested in exploring the concept of the cosmology in a deeper more mechanics-driven way. 

Overall I fell like I get it, so that's good. If you make any changes, I'd love to see the next iteration.

replies.author: Reckonerxy
replies.body:
Thank you for the feedback! I would be also happy to try again if you add a tutorial again on your game as well.

Im also curious about the box issue you encountered. which browser are you using to play? (should work on safari, chrome and edge)

About the stats, later in the game you can unlock damage preview for attacks, should be unlocked after losing the first run (roguelike style)

Im still working on improving the ui as i agree with you that is still barebones.
